g.text: VISUAL LAB / ROUND 2 / CODE CONTROL · NOT NEURAL INFERENCE

127 rig parts / 云台部件 · 12/12 measured checks / 项实测检查
Requested roll / 请求滚转 60° → fixed-world-up baseline discrepancy / 简化基线误差 60.00°
Synthetic rig. Measured code and GPU object counts, not video quality, display latency or physical certification.
